info.name: iiDENTIFii Forum API
info.description:
Every endpoint the forum exposes, including the failure cases. Run the folders top to bottom; requests that need an identifier take it from an earlier request, so the collection is repeatable without editing anything.

Set the environment to "Forum local" before running.

request.description: Liveness probe. Not versioned.

item.name: Browsing
item.description: Reading the forum. None of these need an account.

request.description: A page of discussions, newest first. Stores the first identifier for the requests below.

exec: pm.test('newest first', () => { const dates = body.items.map(p => new Date(p.createdAt).getTime()); pm.expect(dates).to.eql([...dates].sort((a,b) => b-a)); });
pm.test('anonymous readers have liked nothing', () => pm.expect(body.items.every(p => p.likedByMe === false)).to.be.true);

request.description: One discussion, in the same shape as a list entry.
Replies to one discussion, oldest first.

exec: pm.test('belongs to the discussion', () => pm.expect(body.items.every(c => c.postId === pm.collectionVariables.get('postId'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('oldest first', () => { const dates = body.items.map(c => new Date(c.createdAt).getTime()); pm.expect(dates).to.eql([...dates].sort((a,b) => a-b)); });

item.name: Second page does not repeat the first

request.description: Ordering is stable, so consecutive pages never share a discussion.

exec: pm.test('shares no discussion with the first page', () => pm.expect(ids.filter(id => firstPageIds.includes(id))).to.be.empty);

item.name: Filtering and sorting
item.description: Narrowing and ordering the list. Filters combine, and ordering is total so paging never repeats a discussion.

request.description: Only one member's discussions.
Usernames are compared without regard to case.

exec: pm.test('and they are the same author', () => pm.expect(body.items.every(p => p.author.username === 'alice')).to.be.true);

request.description: Only discussions a moderator has flagged.
Popularity first. Stores the identifiers to check paging below.
The other direction of the default ordering.

item.name: Paging by likes does not repeat a discussion

request.description: Many discussions share a like count, so this is where an ambiguous order would show.

item.name: Second page by likes shares nothing with the first

request.description: Proves the ordering is total.
Both conditions apply, rather than the last one winning.
Replies default to oldest first; this reverses them.

item.name: Accounts
item.description: Creating an account and confirming its address. The requests run in order and take what they need from each other, including reading the email out of Mailpit, so the folder can be run repeatedly without editing anything.

request.description: Creates an account. The username is generated so the folder can be run again and again.

item.name: Failure cases
item.description: The API is judged on what it does when a request is wrong, not only when it is right.

request.description: Paging starts at 1.

item.name: Page size above the cap is refused

request.description: A cap keeps one caller from asking for everything at once.
A well-formed identifier that matches nothing.

item.name: Identifier that is not a UUID does not match

request.description: The route only accepts a UUID, so this never reaches the service.

item.name: Replies to an unknown discussion report not found

request.description: Asking for replies does not silently return an empty page.

item.name: A range that ends before it starts is refused

request.description: The two bounds are validated against each other.

exec: pm.test('names the bounds', () => { const keys = Object.keys(pm.response.json().errors); pm.expect(keys.some(k => k === 'From' || k === 'To')).to.be.true; });

request.description: Only the documented orderings are accepted.
Only the documented flags are accepted.

item.name: A page number that would overflow is refused

request.description: Skipping to this page would overflow, so it is refused rather than failing.

item.name: A username already taken is refused

request.description: Uniqueness is enforced by the database, not by reading first. The name it clashes with is the one the Accounts folder registered, so that folder has to have run.

exec: throw new Error('Run the Accounts folder first: it registers the name this request expects to clash with.');

item.name: A username with punctuation is refused

request.description: Letters, numbers and underscores only.
Eight characters at least.

item.name: A token nobody issued is refused

request.description: An unknown token is treated exactly like an expired one.
